questions.prompt: What does a folder named @analytics create in the App Router?

options.text: A parallel-route slot passed to the layout as a named prop

questions.explanation: An @name folder is a parallel-route slot; it's rendered as a named prop in the layout and does not affect the URL.

questions.prompt: Which file provides a slot's fallback when it has no match for the current URL? Type the file name.
questions.explanation: default.tsx is the fallback for an unmatched slot; without it, a hard reload can 404.

questions.prompt: Which statements are true? Select all that apply.

options.text: The @ prefix on a slot folder does not change the URL
Each slot can have its own loading.tsx and error.tsx
Intercepting routes load a route within the current layout
Parallel slots must all render the exact same content

questions.explanation: Slots don't affect the URL, can have independent loading/error, and intercepting routes render within the current layout. Slots render independent content.

questions.prompt: Match each intercepting-route convention to its meaning.

pairs.right: Intercept a segment at the same level
A slot to render the intercepted route in

questions.explanation: The parentheses conventions target how far up the segment is; the @modal slot displays the intercepted route as a dialog.

questions.prompt: Order the modal-pattern behavior when a user clicks a photo link.

items.text: An intercepting route captures it into the @modal slot
The photo shows as a modal over the current page
Refreshing that URL instead renders the full photo page

questions.explanation: The interception shows the route as a modal during in-app navigation, while a direct visit/refresh renders the full page.
